content:
incident-bot: ALERT: Elevated 5xx rate detected for inference-gateway (us-west1). Spike started ~1770012300. Top symptom: repeated 502/504 responses on /v1/generate. Possible upstream: model-runner node crashes (OOM/segfault).

incident-bot: link: https://dash.redwood.internal/incidents/1770012345  | runbook: https://wiki.redwood.internal/runbooks/inference-5xx

sre_amanda: On it — I'm taking pager. Moving to #incident-bridge and tagging eng-runtime. @alice_runtime @eva_platform please join.

alice_runtime: Joining. I see a cluster of crashes from model-runner-45 on us-west1-a. Kernel shows SIGSEGV + OOMkiller entries.

alice_runtime: logs snippet:
```
[2026-03-16T21:12:04Z] model-runner[pid=2345]: Segmentation fault (sig=11)
[2026-03-16T21:12:05Z] kernel: Memory cgroup out of memory: Kill process 2345 (model-runner) score 987
```

ben_oncall: Customer impact? How many requests failing and which tenants?

maria_support: Multiple customers reporting 502s. Error rate jumped from 0.4% -> 6.2% in the last 5m. Top impacted endpoints: /v1/generate, /v1/chat. Top customers: acme-inc (high), learnlytics (medium).

alice_runtime: Heap growth observed in model artifact loading path — likely a leak when running long prompts. Repro on smaller inputs locally by replaying the failing request pattern.

eva_platform: Quick mitigation plan:
- Step A: Drain traffic from us-west1 to us-west2 for non-urgent customers (apply routing weight shift)
- Step B: Scale model-runner pool in us-west1 by +2 nodes (to reduce packing pressure)
- Step C: Enable fallback route to model-v1-quant for high error-rate customers

alice_runtime: Executing scale now and will restart the 3 crashed pods one-by-one (avoid thundering restarts). Command I ran:
```
kubectl -n inference scale deployment/model-runner --replicas=12 --context=us-west1
kubectl -n inference rollout restart deployment/model-runner -l zone=us-west1-a
```

deploy-bot: INFO: Triggered rollout restart for deployment/model-runner in us-west1 (rollout id: r-1770012345-1).

sre_amanda: Routing change in progress. @eva_platform can you start gradual 30% weight shift to us-west2 for public traffic? Keep canary 10% to verify latencies.

eva_platform: Started traffic shift. 10% -> 30% over 2 minutes. Observability alerting configured for latency > 800ms or 5xx > 1% in target region.

alice_runtime: After restarting one of the nodes, I see memory usage drop and no immediate segfaults. However heap still trending up on long prompts. Pushing a hotfix: guard when loading model artifacts to limit cache growth.

alice_runtime: Hotfix diff (pseudo):
```
- cache.insert(model_id, tensor_views)
+ if (cache.size() < MAX_CACHE_ENTRIES) cache.insert(model_id, tensor_views)
```

deploy-bot: INFO: Hotfix queued to canary pool in us-west1 (image: model-runner:patch-1770012345). Canary 2 pods.

maria_support: Customer update drafted: "We are investigating elevated 502/504 errors affecting inference requests in us-west1. Traffic mitigation in progress; some requests may be routed to nearby regions. We'll provide updates in 30 minutes." Approve?

sre_amanda: Approve. Post now. Add note about possible increased tail latency for routed requests.

eva_platform: Canary looks good (2/2 healthy), rolling to remainder in us-west1 in waves. Scaling + restarting completed. 5xx rate dropped from 6.2% -> 1.1% in 10 minutes after mitigation.

ben_oncall: Good improvement. Any durable action items?

alice_runtime: Action items:
- Root cause: unbounded cache growth on artifact load for long prompts -> OOM -> segfaults.
- Short term: hotfix guard + reroute policy + scale-up completed.
- Mid term: add allocation caps + e2e stress tests for long prompt shapes.
- Postmortem owner: alice_runtime. ETA initial draft in 48h.

sre_amanda: I'll keep the bridge open and watch for 30m. If 5xx < 0.5% and no re-crash, we'll close. Thanks everyone for fast coord. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: UPDATE: 5xx rate by region (now): us-west1=0.9%, us-west2=0.2% | customer-impact: degraded for acme-inc and learnlytics (partial). Monitoring for 60m.

ben_oncall: Acknowledged. Please escalate to infra if we see recurrence.

alice_runtime: Noted. Capturing logs and core dumps to S3://incidents/1770012345 for postmortem. Will attach repro and timeline.

sre_amanda: Closing note: we successfully mitigated via routing + hotfix + scale. Bridge will remain open for 30m then I'll close the incident if stable.

incident-bot: INCIDENT: mitigated (monitoring) — incident channel will be updated after postmortem is filed.
